company.name: United Finance
company.shortDescription: United Finance offers a wide range of financing products, corporate deposits and bancassurance for automobile, small and medium enterprises.
company.description: Established in 1997, United Finance Company (SAOG) is one of the leading finance companies operating in Oman. The company started its business with RO 5 million in the capital, one office at Muscat and 5 competitors, 4 being older than 10 years. Over the years, the company has established a niche market for itself in automobile financing and small and medium enterprises financing. The company has an asset base of RO 115 million, over 10,000 satisfied customers, 7 branches and 145 employees.

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Post IPO Debt round raised $39,011,399, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 58 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 59 (-3).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
